I have received a response from Brad. He has identified a time that works for all four partners: Thursday at 14:30. My next step is to create the booking in the firm's booking system for this time. After I create the booking, I need to let Brad know so he can send the confirmation email. I can do both of these things in this session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
